title.zh: Ethereum Sets October 26 for Glamsterdam Upgrade on Hoodi Testnet, Raising Gas L
title.en: Ethereum Sets October 26 for Glamsterdam Upgrade on Hoodi Testnet, Raising Gas L

current_state.zh: The Ethereum Foundation scheduled the Glamsterdam upgrade to activate on the Hoodi testnet on October 26 at 17:42 UTC, lifting the block gas limit to 200 million and introducing ePBS, block-level access lists, and revised gas pricing for state creation and data access.
current_state.en: The Ethereum Foundation scheduled the Glamsterdam upgrade to activate on the Hoodi testnet on October 26 at 17:42 UTC, lifting the block gas limit to 200 million and introducing ePBS, block-level access lists, and revised gas pricing for state creation and data access.
